_comment: kilnCtl coupling-matrix preset. DATA ONLY -- never compiled into any
firmware image (see tools/PcTools/README.md 'Config presets').
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: to get an interpretable A/B against
coupling_matrix_20260831.json (the matrix adopted by commit 78f2134,
packaged into a real preset by eb17ea5), we need a rested-start profile-7
firing on the OLD matrix -- the one that was live on the bench
immediately before that adoption. The only rested-start baseline on file
(logs/coupling/p7_fuzzy0_http.jsonl) started 8.8-10.9 C warmer than the
new-matrix run and pid_ab_compare correctly refused to compare them.
This preset lets that OLD matrix be re-applied exactly, from a rested
start, for a matched comparison.
THE OLD MATRIX, [affected][stepped], diagonal zero. Source: the '-'
(removed) side of commit 78f2134's diff to
tools/PcTools/config_presets/tuned_baseline_20260831.json -- i.e. the
coupling_c0/c1/c2 fields that were actually live on the bench board
immediately before the adoption commit overwrote them. That file is a
kilnctl_backup snapshot, not a schema-valid preset (list_config_presets
rejects it, same defect coupling_matrix_20260831.json's _comment
describes), so its numbers are transplanted here into a real preset
exactly as coupling_matrix_20260831.json did for the new matrix:
DISAGREEMENT WITH PID_EXPANSION_PLAN.md SEC 2 -- FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED:
sec 2 also records a coupling matrix ('Identified plant... Coupling
matrix in wire form [stepped][affected]: z0 39.25/15.78/9.70, z1
to [affected][stepped] and with the diagonal dropped (diagonal is
force-ranged to 0 on the board regardless), that is: zone0
NONE of which match the values pulled from 78f2134's diff above. Sec 2's
matrix is evidently an earlier identification from a different session
(the doc itself, sec 3.2, separately reports 'condition number 4.64 vs
5.27 for the current matrix' when adopting the new one -- 5.27, not sec
2's RGA-diagonal figures, ties it to the 78f2134-diff values instead).
This preset uses the 78f2134-diff values because they are what was
actually live on the board pre-adoption -- the thing RUN A needs to
reproduce -- not sec 2's earlier, seemingly superseded, identification.
Report this disagreement rather than silently picking a side.
EVERY OTHER PER-ZONE FIELD BELOW is copied verbatim from
coupling_matrix_20260831.json (itself a verbatim GET /api/zones snapshot
of the live bench board), so applying THIS preset changes only the
coupling matrix relative to that one -- an isolated A/B variable.
THE WORKING PATH to put this on a live board (see
firmware/KilnFW/docs/PID_EXPANSION_PLAN.md sec 3.2):
config_presets.load_preset_data('coupling_matrix_pre20260902'), then
config_presets.apply_preset(control, preset, zones_host=<esp-ip>) --
coupling_coeff has no UART setter, so zones_host must be given or the
matrix is reported in not_written and never reaches the board at all.
name: coupling_matrix_pre20260902
description: Pre-adoption 3-zone coupling matrix (live on the bench immediately before commit 78f2134), overlaid on the same bench PID/relay/limit config as coupling_matrix_20260831.json so the two presets differ only in the coupling matrix.
